verdict.rationale: Check is a payroll API platform that handles sensitive employee data and offers AI tooling (MCP server, CLI), so a policy on AI-training data use is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack contains no statement, setting, or policy about opting out of AI model training. The read-only MCP mode and IP-restricted API keys are adjacent access controls, not training opt-outs. The community complaint is about ad-tracking data collection, not AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
